name: Extra Favored Form
body:
You are adept at assuming more effective forms than normal.

Prerequisite(s): Shapeshifter favored form class feature.

Benefit(s): You gain an extra favored form.

Special: This feat can be taken multiple times. Each time you take the feat, it applies to a new form.
